representedDate: Standing fort, monuments and gardens as visible in 2026
wholePhysicalScope: Standing Lalbagh Fort precinct: the Tomb of Bibi Pari, western mosque, Dewan-i-Aam with hammam, southern ramparts and the monumental southeast gate.
lodDetails: All four levels preserve the mosque, domed tomb, hammam and Bengal-roofed audience hall, southeast gateway and native fort-wall alignment. Near tiers add recessed arches, turret bands, drainage and garden hedges.
limitations: The 2026 images support the tomb and hall. Mosque details, the gate and wall sections use the mapped geometry and written heritage descriptions, with estimated details where dimensions or active surfaces are missing.

The model includes the four principal surviving structures and southern fortified walls. Garden beds follow the current mapped outlines. Elevations, less-visible masonry, parapet intervals and active water levels are approximations.
